deck_title: Haeberli-Poynton CIE Rec.709 luminance-preserving saturation vs naive equal-weight gray collapse rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Paul Haeberli (Grafica Obscura 1993) & Charles Poynton (ITU-R BT.709 / sRGB) CIE relative luminance-preserving saturation projection (Y = dot(C, vec3(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722)), C_out(u) = mix(C, vec3(Y), u), locking relative luminance ratio Y_out / Y_in = 1.0000x across all 17 desaturation stations u in [0.0000, 1.0000] with 0/17 distorted stations) versus naive equal-weight arithmetic mean gray desaturation (M = (R + G + B) / 3, which ignores human photopic V(lambda) sensitivity and drains green-dominant CIE luminance as 1 - 0.5u to 0.8750x at u=0.25, 0.7500x at u=0.50, and 0.5000x / -50.00% at u=1.00 across 16/17 stations while blowing out pure blue by 4.62x) and 64-band CIE photopic spectral quadrature.
